description: MainActivity class for a minimalist Android calculator app, handling UI setup, user interactions, and basic arithmetic operations (addition and subtraction).

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for the calculator app, managing UI components, user input, and calculation logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and event listeners.

methods.name: setUpStyling
methods.description: Applies styling to UI elements, such as elevation.

methods.name: setUpListeners
methods.description: Sets click listeners for number buttons, operators, and actions.

methods.name: resetState
methods.description: Resets calculator state and updates display.

methods.name: updateDisplay
methods.description: Updates the calculator display with optional animation.

methods.name: handleDigit
methods.description: Handles digit input, manages input validation and display update.

methods.name: parseCurrentInput
methods.description: Parses current input string to Long.

methods.name: applyPendingOperator
methods.description: Applies the pending operator to the current input and accumulator.

methods.name: handleOperator
methods.description: Handles operator button presses, updates state and UI.

methods.name: emphasizeOperator
methods.description: Visually emphasizes the selected operator button.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Performs calculation based on current input and operator, updates display.
